description: One day's blood oxygen (Pulse Ox): average, lowest and latest SpO2 (%), the average during sleep and Garmin's 7-day average. Set include_samples for hourly averages with altitude (m), e.g. for altitude acclimation. SpO2 is only recorded when Pulse Ox is on in the watch settings.

date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in the user's time zone.

include_samples.description: Include hourly SpO2 and altitude. Default false.

name: garmin_get_spo2
title: Get Garmin SpO2
